title: Finders Tell Their Friends
logline: A jungle of entrepreneurial opportunity sits under a floating protopian island called Founder Paradise, an island nobody steers, not even the founders who made it up. The only way up is a portal: each era gets one, a tall door of warm light hidden in the green, and it shrinks. The more founders pass through and the longer it stands open, the smaller it gets, until it closes and leaves a ring of pale gold flowers for the myths to grow around. The island's keepers want as many through as they can get, so they parachute down small crates holding smart orange compasses whose needles swing toward the live portal. Maya works harder than anyone, follows a myth to a closed portal, watches a prophet's broadcast arrive after the light has shrunk too small for a crowd, and learns what the myths and the smudged advice never say: the seekers who make it hold a sky-compass and have friends who tell them first. She joins a small circle that shares maps honestly, steps through with her friends, and tells it straight from above, while this era's portal, opened wider than any before it and closing faster than any has closed, still stands somewhere in the green.
spineNote: The argued object is WHY HARD WORK ALONE DOES NOT BEAT THE CLOSING LIGHT. Three false channels are examined and dismissed in order (myth from below, mistranslated stories from above, broadcast from a prophet), and the true channel is demonstrated rather than asserted: a keepers' sky-compass in hand and a small circle whose rule is that whoever finds it tells the others first. The coda closes the loop the false channels opened, and then opens the door outward: this era's portal is open NOW, wider than any before and closing faster than any has closed (both carried as rumor, because rumor is the book's texture), so the last image is a hopeful mid-search with real hope. Keep looking: urgency with warmth, never dread. REVISED 2026-08-08 (Gary, portal reconstruction): the space elevator is GONE; the way up is a shrinking portal, one per era. Founder Heaven renamed Founder Paradise, and the island drifts (even the winners are passengers). The compasses are smart devices parachuted down in crates by the keepers. Prior mechanics (elevators, the unexplained dark): see git history.

beats.text: There is a jungle where the hopeful go. It is green and loud and alive, and it does not care how good your plan is. Everyone who walks in is looking for the same thing: a way up.
beats.provenance: Gary's commission brief, 2026-08-07: 'a wild jungle of entrepreneurial opportunity, full of dangers, where hopefuls search for a way up'.

beats.text: Up is an island in the sky. It floats above the canopy in plain view, near enough to see its gardens and its bright machines, too far for any tree to reach. The people below call it Founder Paradise. Nobody steers it, not even the founders who made it up. It drifts where it drifts, and the winners ride along.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: renamed Founder Paradise; new lore: nobody steers the island, it drifts, the winners ride along. (Prior text: see git history.)

beats.text: There is one way up. Each era, one portal opens somewhere in the jungle: a tall door of warm light standing in the green. The jungle hides it the way it hides everything. You can cut a trail past it at arm's length and never know.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: the elevator is gone; each era gets one portal, a tall door of warm light hidden in the green. The arm's-length line kept from the elevator draft. (Prior text: see git history.)

beats.text: A portal starts wide enough for anyone who finds it. But every founder who steps through leaves it a little smaller, and every day it stands open it shrinks a little more, until one day it closes for good. The hopefuls call the time it is open a window. Rumor says the windows close faster every time.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: the shrink mechanics. More founders through plus more days open means smaller, until it closes for good. 'Window' kept as the hopefuls' name. 'Rumor says the windows close faster every time' carried AS rumor per Gary. (Prior text: see git history.)

beats.text: When a portal closes, it leaves a ring of pale gold flowers where the light once stood. The people who missed it gather there and tell stories about the ones who stepped through in time. The stories grow taller every season. That is how myths get written: by the people still on the ground.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: a closed portal leaves a ring of pale gold flowers (the drawable trace the myths gather around; design decision this run, flagged for Gary). Myth-writing lines kept. (Prior text: see git history.)

beats.text: The founders up top tell stories too, and send them down. The pages fall a long way, and they land smudged into advice that points at nothing. So the island's keepers send something surer. Small crates drift down under parachutes, and inside each one is a smart orange compass whose needle always swings toward the live portal. The keepers want as many through as they can get. Rumor says the ones holding a sky-compass find the portal long before anyone else.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: the keepers parachute small crates holding smart orange compasses; needle swings to the live portal; 'Rumor says the ones holding a sky-compass find the portal long before anyone else' carried AS rumor per Gary. (Prior text: see git history.)

beats.text: Maya works harder than anyone in the jungle. She is up before the light, she carries her work everywhere, and she clears more trail in a week than most camps clear in a season. Hard work is her plan. She is sure it is enough.
beats.provenance: Brief arc: 'one seeker who works harder than everyone'.

beats.text: She follows the most famous myth in the jungle to the place where a great portal once stood. It is exactly where the story said: a quiet ring of pale gold flowers in the green. It has been closed for years. The myth was true. It was just finished.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: the myth leads to a closed portal's blossom ring. 'The myth was true. It was just finished.' kept verbatim. (Prior text: see git history.)

beats.text: One day a famous prophet arrives, and a million followers arrive behind him. He climbs the tallest rock and announces the portal's location to everyone at once. He is not lying. But a portal shrinks with every founder who passes through, and by the time anything can be announced to a million people, this one has shrunk too small for a crowd. Broadcast means too late.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: the prophet announces the portal's location only when it has already shrunk too small for a crowd. Broadcast means too late, kept verbatim. He is still never lying, never a villain. (Prior text: see git history.)

beats.text: That night Maya counts every founder she has ever known who made it up. Not one of them found their portal in a myth or an announcement. Each one had a friend who found it and told them first, quietly, the same hour. Finders tell their friends.
beats.provenance: Brief moral: 'the seekers who make it are the ones whose friends clue them in the moment they find one.' Portal reconstruction 2026-08-08: 'their elevator' became 'their portal'; otherwise verbatim.

beats.text: So she stops searching alone. She finds Chrissy, who lights up when she has something to share, and the engineer, who says plainly what he knows and what he does not. They draw their maps honestly, dead ends and all. A compass from the sky sits on the map where all three can read it, and they keep one rule: whoever finds it tells the others first.
beats.provenance: Gary's revision, 2026-08-08: the circle now holds a compass from the sky beside the honest maps; a compass in hand plus a friend who tells you first is how you make it in time. (Prior text and provenance: see git history.)

beats.text: It is Chrissy who finds it, on an ordinary morning, where the needle pointed, behind a curtain of vines she almost did not pull back. She does not climb a rock. She does not gather a crowd. She turns around and goes to get her friends.
beats.provenance: Gary's revision, 2026-08-08: one clause added ('where the needle pointed') so the find follows the compass the circle keeps; the vines still nearly hide it, which is the camouflage's power. (Prior text and provenance: see git history.)

beats.text: The portal is warm as a doorway at dusk, and it is still wide enough for every friend who comes. They step through together, out of the green and into the sky, and Founder Paradise comes up like a sunrise.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: they step through together; still wide enough for every friend who comes (capacity warmth kept); Founder Paradise comes up like a sunrise. Kills the shipped spread-13 composition Gary flagged (vertical shaft parallel to the island).

beats.text: Founder Paradise is smaller than the myths and kinder than the smudged advice. And nearly everyone who stands there arrived the same way: holding a map a friend drew.
beats.provenance: Brief: protopian island, plus the moral generalized from the arrival side. Portal reconstruction 2026-08-08: Founder Heaven renamed Founder Paradise; otherwise verbatim.

beats.text: Maya remembers the pages that fall and smudge. So she writes her story plainly and checks every word before she sends it down. I worked hard, and hard work was not enough. I held a compass from the sky, and a friend found the way and told me first. Work hard. Hold your compass. Find the friends who would tell you. Be one back.
beats.provenance: Gary's revision, 2026-08-08: the moral gains the compass: work hard, hold your compass, find the friends who would tell you, be one back. (Prior text and provenance: see git history.)

beats.text: Somewhere below, a hopeful reads a page that finally says what happened, and the needle of her sky-compass swings. This era's portal is open right now. Rumor says it opened wider than any portal before it. Rumor says it is closing faster than any portal has closed. So work hard. Hold your compass. Find the friends who would tell you first, and be one back. And from above, tell it straight. The light is standing somewhere in the green. Keep looking.
beats.provenance: Gary's portal reconstruction, 2026-08-08: the urgency close. This era's portal open NOW, opened wider than any before it, closing faster than any has closed, both carried as rumor. Moral spine kept intact (work hard, hold your compass, friends who would tell you first, be one back, tell it straight). 'Keep looking' is the emotional note: urgency with warmth, never dread. Ending direction worked out with Gary ('this feels promising').
